THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
Reference No.: 6/3/1/493.
I, hereby give notice, under Sub - section (1) of Section 7 ofthe Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends toacquire the following land which is required for a publicpurpose:
